notes.title: Ghost Town OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/eba459f2841cf402f4f6b0b0854568a7692be3fd.jpg

The wait is finally over! GHOST TOWN IS OUT NOW on Steam with a 10% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

We've been hard at work crafting Ghost Town over the past 4 years(!) so we're super excited to get it in to your hands & to hear what you think of it. 

As an independent developer, reviews play a big part in raising awareness of the game while also directly telling us what you thought about it. Please show your support by writing a review, we'll be actively keeping an eye out for any coming through! 

We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Ghost Town!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: Next Fest is here & Ghost Town is part of it!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/85bce08c40510927509e432beafad668cb9c3686.jpg
Steam Next Fest is here! 

Our demo for Ghost Town is part of the celebration & we'd love for you to give it a try!

If you have any feedback or encounter any problems, please head on over to our Demo Discussion Board which we'll be keeping an eye on.

Be sure to Wishlist Ghost Town so you're notified when the full game comes out. The release date isn't confirmed yet, but it'll be sometime this Summer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/
We hope you enjoy our demo & the other games on show during Next Fest!

Until next time!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: THE ROOM VR: A DARK MATTER PRICE REDUCTION
notes.content:
The Room VR: A Price Reduction
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/c44b463730bf0c015948708c028bd40c616a52b8.png
As of March this year, The Room VR: A Dark Matter has been out for 5 years!

We're super proud that The Room VR continued the Overwhelmingly Positive tradition of The Room series, achieving that rating across more than 3500 reviews.

With that in mind, and to celebrate the upcoming launch of Ghost Town on Steam, we've made the decision to permanently lower the base price of The Room VR. So if you were on the fence about pulling the trigger, now might be the time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104380/The_Room_VR_A_Dark_Matter

That's all for now! We'll be back when we have anything else exciting to share!

notes.title: Ghost Town Update & Big Fireproof Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/5dc73919ba3243ceb896dc79951b8cea3f687b31.jpg

Hello there!

It's been a while, so we figured a couple of update are in order!

Ghost Town - Meta Quest Store launch
We've been keeping busy since our initial announcement last October getting Ghost Town all polished up for it's Meta Quest store release, which happened last Thursday!

The reception has been wonderful to see, with critic and player reviews almost unanimously positive so far. We've been glued to our screens waiting on every new video, review or comment to come through!

Upload VR put together a particularly glowing piece if anyone fancies a bit of further reading!

Ghost Town - Steam release coming soon
Now that Ghost Town has released on Quest we're focussing our attention on the PC (Steam) & PSVR2 versions. We don't quite have a date in the calendar that we can share yet, however as soon as we're confident on a launch day we'll let you know!

Wishlist below to keep on top of any new updates -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/?curator_clanid=33026102

Fireproof Games Sale!
In celebration of the Ghost Town's Meta launch, we're running a 2 week sale, which is live NOW, on all of our other games! This sale is the biggest we've ever done across all our title so if you were looking to grab one now's the time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/288160/The_Room/?curator_clanid=33026102
https://store.steampowered.com/app/425580/The_Room_Two/?curator_clanid=33026102
https://store.steampowered.com/app/456750/The_Room_Three/?curator_clanid=33026102
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/?curator_clanid=33026102
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104380/The_Room_VR_A_Dark_Matter/?curator_clanid=33026102

That's all for now! We'll be back once we have news on Ghost Town's steam release date OR if we have anything else exciting to share!

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 2
notes.content:
Fixes:

 Gargoyle spinners in the Garden spinning forever/glitching out and forcing player to restart the chapter
 Steam Achievements not popping up in game 
 Level complete messages weren't displaying correctly on Turkish language Windows
 On high refresh monitors, the constellation puzzles in the Foyer would sometimes lock up making the puzzle difficult to solve
 Tweaked the appearance of the glass panels in the Foyer box to make them more obvious

notes.title: The Room: Old Sins - OVERWHELMINGLY POSITIVE!!!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38971635/8da17ac5218f3984235d4a6b60e63119c3429ac5.jpg

Now look what you've gone and done! ːsteamhappyː 

The Room 4: Old Sins has achieved an "Overwhelmingly Positive" average review rating after only a few days! This is by far the fastest any of The Room games has hit this milestone!

A huge heartfelt thank you to anyone who has bought, streamed or positively reviewed the game - we've been absolutely blown away by the response so far!

I'm sure most folks who are reading this have already bought the game or added it to their wishlist, but if not you can do that here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/

We're keeping an eye on the discussions board for any issues or questions that pop up. Our first patch was released today, with another likely coming in the next week.

Thanks again for the amazing reception, you've already made our week!

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: The Room 4: Old Sins - OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
The day is finally here! The Room 4: Old Sins is available now on Steam for PC!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/
Much like with The Room Three's PC release back in 2018, Old Sins has been a frequently requested title since it's mobile launch and something we've been working away on since the start of 2020. It's been a very different development cycle for us this time around with everyone working from home, however it hasn't stopped us creating something we're super proud of!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38971635/523a98ccb30cba48cc7902b08923712ec57b7b74.jpg

A massive thank you to all our fans for your patience and support! We hope you love Old Sins as much as we do and enjoy exploring every inch of Waldegrave Manor!

Take care and happy clicking!

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: The Room: Old Sins - Two weeks until launch!
notes.content:
TWO WEEKS TO GO!

After a year or so in development, everyone at Fireproof is eagerly anticipating the launch of The Room 4: Old Sins on February 11th! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins
For those that haven't visited our Steam page yet, check out the comparison trailer below for a sneak peek at some of the improvements made in the PC version!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArPdlXTw6Kk Every asset and environment has been meticulously re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room 4: Old Sins to life.

Not long now before you can see for yourselves!

- Fireproof Games Team
